verses.1: Therefore, we must pay more attention to those who are listening, even if we may be overlooked in the process.
verses.2: For if the words spoken through the prophets were true, then any violations or deviations from those words would deserve punishment.
verses.3: How can we be forgiven for having been so negligent in this matter of salvation? From the beginning, it was said that it should be done through the Lord’s authority, and it was confirmed by those who heard about it.
verses.4: They testified to the signs and wonders of God, as well as through various powers and holy spirits, according to His will.
verses.5: For he did not command the messengers about the future events that would happen. This is what we are talking about.
verses.6: He also said something like this: What kind of person is it to imitate him? Or what kind of human being is it to observe him?
verses.7: I appointed him to a short position in the office of messenger. I also honored and praised him greatly.
verses.8: I have always placed everything under his feet. For it is impossible for anything to be left unplaced under his feet. Now, we will see that everything is indeed placed under him.
verses.9: And we see that Jesus, who was briefly deceived by the angels, was crowned with glory and honor through his suffering of death. Thus, he will experience death as nothing more than a temporary condition, not beyond the reach of God’s control.
verses.10: For it was necessary for him to bring many sons into glory through whom all things could be accomplished. He became the leader of their salvation, after enduring many hardships.
verses.11: For both those who are holy and those who are being sanctified, they all share the same status. So, why doesn’t he also call his brothers by their names?
verses.12: I say: I will announce your name to my brothers. I will praise you in the midst of the congregation.
verses.13: And once again, I will believe in him. And once again, I see that I and my children are those whom God has given to me.
verses.14: Since the children were covered in blood and flesh, and he himself participated closely in their deaths, so that through death he could destroy the ruler who possessed such power over others—this is what hell is.
verses.15: And release these people, who were guilty of death due to their fear of living under any kind of oppression.
verses.16: For it is not from some messenger that it is received, but from the seed of Abraham.
verses.17: It was from this that he could be like all his brothers in every way, so that he could become a faithful high priest before God, and thus be able to forgive the sins of the people.
verses.18: For in whom he was tried, he can indeed help those who are being tried.
